title: IRE Knowledge Document Front Matter
description: JSON Schema for the ire_doc YAML front matter block. Valid taxonomy values are in ire-taxonomy.yaml.

type.description: What kind of artifact this is.

area.description: Which IRE platform area this document belongs to. Use 'area' not 'domain' — ServiceNow uses Domain for Domain Separation.

perspective.description: The lens an AI or human reader should apply when reading this document.

intent.description: What the author needs from the reader.

author.description: Intel username of the primary author, e.g. jmonroe. Must match an entry in docs/ire-knowledge-schema.yaml authors list (advisory only).

created.description: ISO 8601 date this document was created, e.g. 2026-07-01.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of last significant content change.

project.description: Optional. Which IRE sub-project this document belongs to.

supersedes.description: Optional. Filename (relative to docs/) of the document this replaces. Set the replaced doc status to 'superseded'.

expires.description: Optional. ISO 8601 date after which this document should be reviewed or retired. Useful for status snapshots and runbooks that go stale.

schema_version.description: Schema version used when this document was created. Do not edit manually.

ai_index.description: Instructions and tags for AI indexing, RAG pipelines, and summarization tools.

summary_prompt.description: One sentence telling AI how to summarize this document. Example: 'Summarize this as a ServiceNow CMDB change justification.'

tags.description: Tags for indexing. Prefer values from ire-taxonomy.yaml.

do_not_summarize.description: Set true to exclude this document from AI summarization and indexing.
